description:
Free tool — no Zooza API call, no company_id required. Two modes:
  "start" → returns the 8-question interview template for Claude to conduct conversationally.
  "build" → validates answers against the Zooza glossary, returns a TerminologyProfile JSON
            plus a /remember instruction so Claude saves the profile to memory.
Run once per user. The saved profile is auto-loaded in every future Zooza session — no
re-configuration needed. Call get_skill('negotiate-terminology') before starting the interview.

action.description: "start" — returns the 8-question interview template (call this first, then ask the user the questions conversationally). "build" — validates collected answers and returns TerminologyProfile JSON + /remember instruction.

answers.description: Required when action is "build". Omit for action "start".

billing_period_term.description: What the user calls a Billing Period.

booking_term.description: What the user calls a Booking.

class_term.description: What the user calls a Class.

client_term.description: What the user calls a Client / Parent.

locale.description: Primary language code of this business, e.g. 'sk', 'cz', 'en', 'de', 'pl', 'ro', 'hu'.

notes.description: Any additional terminology notes or unusual vocabulary.

programme_term.description: What the user calls a Programme.

session_term.description: What the user calls a Session.

trainer_term.description: What the user calls a Trainer / Instructor.

name: negotiate_terminology
title: Negotiate terminology — build a personalised vocabulary profile
